name: Krackenschtein

facts.text: Level 70, 30,000 health. He takes no damage from attackers further than 300 from him: only those close to him can hurt him.
He casts Bolt of Doom and Thunder Stomp and throws a target to one of four spots; pulling him brings seven gentarns and a wolfentry.
Bot chat jokes that his name proves someone in Fomor has a sense of humour.

story:
Fomor has workshops as well as halls, and in one of them the hydrars and their kin tried to make a champion. They took the strongest parts of their dead and stitched them together and woke the result with a bolt from the sky, and they named it Krackenschtein, which in their tongue may mean nothing at all. It was meant to be unbeatable and very nearly is. Whatever they woke it with clings round it like a storm, and turns aside any harm sent from a distance. Only someone close enough to smell the stitches can hurt it. It stamps, and the floor throws people across the room.

The Fomorians do not have a word for what the workshop does. The hydrars and their kin took the strongest parts of their own dead, hooked them up in a room under the city, stitched them together on a great table, and woke the result with a bolt from the sky, drawn down through a shaft to the shore. They meant to make a champion who could not be beaten. The name they gave it may mean nothing at all; the Sylvan laugh at it, which they rarely do at anything from Fomor.

Whatever woke it clings round it still, a storm in the walls that shrugs off any harm sent from a distance: arrows and spells from across the room simply fail to land, and only someone within arm's reach can hurt it. It calls down the same bolt it was born from, a Bolt of Doom on whoever annoys it, and it stamps until the floor throws people into the four corners of the workshop. Its household is the workshop's guard, seven gentarns and a wolfentry. It does not seem to know it is the city's champion. It seems only to know that it is awake.
legend: Spells and arrows from range do nothing to him. Everyone who wants to hurt him gets inside arm's length; casters with short-range spells can join, the rest heal. He throws people around the room and stamps, so tanks pick him up again fast. Clear his gentarns first. Melee and short-range casters only; archers and long-range casters heal or stand back. Tanks retake it fast after every throw. Clear the gentarns first. Superstition: never say his name three times in the workshop. The Sylvan laugh at it, and he can hear laughter. Nicknames: 'stitches', 'the table', 'the champion nobody ordered'.

loremasterTopic.text: A champion stitched together from the Fomorian dead and woken by lightning. No harm from a distance reaches him; fight him close.

bookPage: Fiachra of Howth writes: I said I would not describe the room with the hooks, and I will keep that promise, mostly. I will say the table was large and the hooks were empty, and that a shaft ran up from the ceiling toward the shore with a smell of storms in it. The Sylvan told me later what lived there, a champion the Fomorians stitched from their own dead and woke with lightning. Nothing thrown from a distance can hurt it, they said; you must go close enough to smell the stitches. I asked who would do such a thing. They said: the realm's warriors, every season.
